name: bzd-review-paper
description: Review mathematical modeling competition papers from a complete contest problem and a team's paper. Independently construct a problem-specific 100-point rubric, optionally import a prior bzd-paper-format-checker result, score every modeling/solution/result block by itemized 1-3 point deductions under a 90%-of-weight ceiling, map the -10-to-10 format score deterministically to a 0-to-1 quality coefficient, estimate contest percentile, and provide concise Chinese judge feedback. Use for CUMCM, MCM/ICM, MathorCup, Huashu Cup, postgraduate modeling contests, and similar paper evaluation requests.

interface.shortDescription: 区分国赛与小型竞赛，生成专属细则并评审得分位次
interface.longDescription: Review mathematical modeling competition papers from a complete contest problem and a team's paper. Independently construct a problem-specific 100-point rubric, optionally import a prior bzd-paper-format-checker result, score every modeling/solution/result block by itemized 1-3 point deductions under a 90%-of-weight ceiling, map the -10-to-10 format score deterministically to a 0-to-1 quality coefficient, estimate contest percentile, and provide concise Chinese judge feedback. Use for CUMCM, MCM/ICM, MathorCup, Huashu Cup, postgraduate modeling contests, and similar paper evaluation requests.
defaultPrompt: 使用 $bzd-review-paper。先确认是否为高教社杯国赛；如已有同版本的 $bzd-paper-format-checker 报告，自动接入其格式分与证据，将-10到10分线性映射为0到1.00的格式质量系数。根据赛题制定百分制细则，把每问拆成模型建立、模型求解、结果与回答；每个板块先按90%封顶，再针对评分细则逐条扣1、2或3分，扣至0分为止；与题目或冻结答案根本不一致的板块归零。最后输出HTML报告和对应竞赛规模的位次估计。
